description.value: The study examined whether neural responses during affect labeling predicted improvements in psychological and physical health outcomes and benefits of expressive writing, using GLM and SVM approaches.

spans.text: In this study, we showed that neural responses during AL can predict changes in psychological and physical health measures, in particular the subsequent benefits of expressive disclosure.
